meta-runner.name: Post GitHub commit status
meta-runner.description: Depends on following TeamCity parameters: * OCTOPUS_GITHUB_TOKEN * TEAMCITY_URL * TEAMCITY_USER * TEAMCITY_PASSWORD Posts a commit status to GitHub so builds can gate branch protection.

param.name: GITHUB_OWNER
param.spec: text description='GitHub organization / owner' validationMode='not_empty' display='normal'

param.name: GITHUB_REPO
param.spec: text description='GitHub repository name' validationMode='not_empty' display='normal'

param.name: COMMIT_SHA
param.spec: text description='Git commit SHA the status is attached to' validationMode='not_empty' display='normal'

param.name: COMMIT_STATUS_STATE
param.spec: select description='Commit status state: pending (build running), success (build passed), failure (build failed), error (unexpected/config problem)' data_1='pending' data_2='success' data_3='failure' data_4='error' display='normal'

param.name: COMMIT_STATUS_CONTEXT
param.spec: text description='Status check context (must match branch protection rule)' validationMode='not_empty' display='normal'

param.name: GITHUB_API_URL
param.spec: text description='GitHub API base URL (change for GitHub Enterprise)' validationMode='not_empty' display='normal'
